scope: Minimal existing autocomplete lifecycle and lazy sort fallback; no ranking/query/price/SEO/UI redesign or database change.
confirmedFindings: Before: initialQuery >=2 characters schedules autocomplete after 250ms without focus. Real SSR/hydration Chrome confirms one API request per loaded result page.
Before: aborting fetch alone does not guard a late response/body/error. Four new lifecycle regressions fail on baseline and pass on revised component.
Before: sort eagerly compares delivered price for every pair, then repeats that comparison for price_asc/price_desc. Other sorts pay that cost before checking their primary key.
searchProducts still needs the full candidate pool for correct ranking, exact-variant price selection, facets, counts and pagination; no blind 24-candidate cutoff is introduced.

serverAudit.products: One products SELECT with nested offers/retailers, active and merge guards, existing text plan and name order.
serverAudit.variants: One bulk active-variant ID SELECT when referenced variants exist; no per-product offer or variant query.
serverAudit.approvedFacts: Existing unique-product batches of 500 and candidate pages of 1000, then in-memory resolution. Database calls scale with batches/pages, not a query per product.
serverAudit.existingOptimization: PR #527 (3bef267e) already reuses normalized offers/relevance between retailer/caffeine passes. It is retained.
serverAudit.remainingWork: Nutrition/offer normalization, global facets, filtering, ranking and final 24-row slice remain unchanged. Page metadata does not call searchProducts. Search parameter links already disable route prefetch.
serverAudit.suggestions: One bounded products/offers query, limit 50; no variant/proof enrichment. Avoiding an unused autocomplete request avoids that query too.
serverAudit.analytics: Existing conditional base-search event INSERT is unchanged; public audit did not request /search and never invoked this write path.
serverAudit.databaseOptimizationBoundary: A later database-side reduction must prove identical exact-variant/freshness/shipping/unit-cost ranking, facets and counts before pagination. No SQL, index or migration is proposed or applied here.

pipelineFixture.method: Actual before/after searchProducts plus real pricing/nutrition/freshness/proof modules, isolated in-memory Supabase transport, 1000 synthetic products/1000 variants/2000 offers; no production credentials or calls. Bytes are serialized fixture JSON, not production network transfer.

performance.caveat: These are local measurements, not Vercel route CPU, production network bytes or field Core Web Vitals.

comparator.method: Comparator microbenchmark, not whole search request or Vercel CPU. Actual baseline/current functions; shared 1000-candidate fixture; 50 warmups, 15 alternating batches of 100 sorts. Process CPU includes user and system time; invocation counts measured separately.

browser.runtime: Chrome; React 19.2.4 development StrictMode; real SSR + hydrateRoot; local fixture API

baselineWithNewAutocompleteRegressions.reason: Expected red: initial fetch, obsolete success/error, obsolete JSON body, blur cancellation.

verification.knownWarnings: Four pre-existing unused-variable ESLint warnings in unchanged scripts/automation-review-queue-pagination.integration.test.js; Windows nested-worktree Next root warning. Neither is suppressed or changed.
verification.integration: NOT_RUN: no SQL or database behavior changes; production credentials never supplied to quality gates.

unverifiedProductionContext.source: Owner-supplied Vercel observations; no authenticated Vercel Observability tool/API available in this session.
unverifiedProductionContext.inference: Some traffic may be automated. Intentional attack is not confirmed. Initial autocomplete waste does not explain CPU from non-JavaScript bots hitting /search directly.
unverifiedProductionContext.waf: Existing targeted browser challenge remains unchanged. Its effect cannot be separated from code savings using raw total CPU alone.

releaseBoundary.review: Push only the requested branch and open a PR. CI must pass for its final SHA; production release requires separate owner approval.
releaseBoundary.rollback: Revert the code commit through the ordinary reviewed release path; no database rollback or cache invalidation system is needed.
afterApprovedRelease: Compare equivalent 30-minute and 24-hour windows with the same targeted WAF rule: CPU per 1000 /search calls and CPU per request, not just totals.
Compare /search-suggestions calls per search page view and active input session, plus query/page/filter/sort mix.
Track /search and suggestions invocation counts, p50/p95 CPU and duration, errors/timeouts and observable Supabase query volume.
Verify focus/typing/keyboard/mobile flows and known current-price, stale, no-result, filter/sort/pagination cases.
Check verified Googlebot/Bingbot WAF logs separately from spoofable user agents; preserve product/category HTTP200, canonical, robots, HTML anchors and schema.
Review mobile/desktop p75 LCP, INP and CLS with adequate traffic; do not infer field CWV from a local component fixture.
